warnings.text: Manual synchronization of Unity Application.persistentDataPath via JS_FileSystem_Sync() is deprecated and will be later removed in a future Unity version. The persistent data directory will be automatically synchronized instead on file modification. Pass config.autoSyncPersistentDataPath = true; to configuration in createUnityInstance() to opt in to the new behavior.
